concerns.location: spec.md:Functional Requirements (missing FR for US-1 preprocessing)
concerns.text: US-1 explicitly requires imputation of missing non-target values, numeric normalization/scaling, and one-hot encoding of categorical metal types (Acceptance Scenarios 1-2), but no FR covers these steps. FR-001 covers only ingestion, column validation, and unit harmonization. Add an FR anchoring imputation/normalization/encoding to US-1.

concerns.location: spec.md:Constitution Principle VII vs Functional Requirements
concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII mandates that no samples from the same experimental batch or source study appear in both train and test sets (group-aware 80/20 split). No FR or SC covers this leakage-prevention split; SC-001 only says 'held-out test set'. Add an FR/SC anchoring group-based splitting to US-2.
SC-002 is anchored '(See US-3)' but the Full-vs-Null model permutation test is defined in US-2 (Acceptance Scenario 3) and FR-002. Re-anchor SC-002 to US-2 (or both) so the traceability is correct.
